skills.description: This skill should be used when a user pastes a Douyin (TikTok CN) share link and wants to save, transcribe, or archive the video or image-text post into a local knowledge base (e.g. Obsidian). It downloads the watermark-free video or images, extracts audio, transcribes speech locally with faster-whisper (no API key required, audio never leaves the device), and produces a transcript.md plus media files. Trigger words include: 抖音转文字, 提取抖音文案, 下载这个抖音视频, 保存抖音图文, 转存到 Obsidian, 把这个抖音存到知识库, 扒一下这个抖音, 批量下载抖音. Supports both v.douyin.com short links and www.douyin.com long links; auto-detects video vs image-text posts and falls back to a real-browser fetch when Douyin's anti-bot shell blocks standard parsing.
skills.description_zh: 把抖音视频 / 图文分享链接一键转存到本地：无水印下载 + **本地 Whisper 转录**（无需 API Key、音频不出本机），自动产出逐字稿与媒体文件，可归档进 Obsidian 等知识库。
